name: LWC Test: Trend-Following Strategy
description: LWC chart integration test. Campaign/strategy that exercises RoundTrip trade markers (entry/exit triangles, P&L coloring, connection lines), SMA crossover signals.
source:
# =============================================================================
# LWC TEST: TREND-FOLLOWING STRATEGY (CAMPAIGN)
# Tests: RoundTrip markers, trade entry/exit, P&L visualization, equity curve
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# === TREND SIGNALS ===
sma_50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Golden cross = bullish entry, Death cross = bearish exit
golden_cross = crossover(sma_50, sma_200)
death_cross = crossunder(sma_50, sma_200)

# === ENTRY / EXIT LOGIC ===
held = hold_until(golden_cross, death_cross)
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)

# === POSITION SIZING ===
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=33.33)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS (overlay lines on price pane)
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Moving Averages',
    category='Price',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 50', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 200', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(sma_50, sma_200))
